record.title: Sudan land-border closure during April2019 military takeover
record.scope: National closure order; observed land impact at Egypt frontier and partial relaxation at Arqin
record.movement: National order broad; Egyptian passengers and students at Arqin specifically documented
record.exceptions: Limited facilitated exit at Arqin from 13 April; other exceptions unestablished
record.enforcement: Egyptian ministry reports passengers stranded by Sudanese land closure and subsequent bus passage arrangements
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; current status not inferred
record.official_rationale: Military takeover and emergency measures after removal of Omar al-Bashir.
record.context: Military announcement suspended constitution and closed border crossings until further notice. Egyptian diplomatic intervention subsequently enabled departure of stranded citizens through Arqin.
record.uncertainty: 13 April is limited Arqin/Egyptian passenger relaxation, not national reopening. PBS fetch blocked, but Reuters/NBC text retrieved in full via Euronews. No entire-border operational duration.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty
